sourceText.he: וּמַאי שְׁנָא מֵהָא דְּתַנְיָא: הַשּׁוֹחֵט וְנִבְלַע דָּם בַּקַּרְקַע – חַיָּיב לְכַסּוֹת. הָתָם כְּשֶׁרִשּׁוּמוֹ נִיכָּר.

positions.claim: one who slaughters and whose blood is absorbed into the ground is obligated to cover it
the baraita speaks only where the blood's impression remains recognizable
